description.text: Why choose to study this program? This prograq is offered by School of Electronic and Information Engineering (SEIE) of Beihang University, one of the earliest department of aeronautic electronic enigeering founded in China with a history of 50 years. Electronic information is a broad-range field. Great attention has been paid to cultivate personnel with technology in comprehensive IT manufacture, public network and private network, focused on electronic information technology applications. Main Courses Introduction of Electronic Information Engineering, Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, Introduction to Aeronautics and Astronautics, Software Technical Fundament, Circuit Analysic, Electromagnetic Field Theory, Signals and Systems, Analog Electronic Circuit, Digital Signal Processing, Electronic Measure etc. Internship and Career Development Students of this program could have many practices, like Engineering Cognition Practice, Metalworking Practice and Electronics Practice. The major is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge in electronic technology and information system, basic theory and techniques of information collection, processing and transmission, and basic practice in electronics and information engineering. It turns out senior engineering and technical personnel who are capable of information processing systems, communications systems and electronic equipment research, design, application development and operation analysis. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Engineering. Accommodation Two room apartment with a bathroom and kitchen: 1,300CNY/Mth. per room* Shared bed-room with a bathroom: 550 CNY/Mth.per bed* Single room with bathroom: 1,100 CNY/Mth. per room* * Electric and water costs are not included.

duration.text: The Electronic Information Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. HSK

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA 2.Applicants should have the equivalent of a high school education 3.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school 4.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general 5.Applicants should have good command of English and the ability to take courses in English; Applicants are required to submit the certificates of 90 or more in TOEFL, 5.5 or more in IELTS or any other proofs about English level. All the applicants should pass the English Level Test at the beginning of the first semester in BUAA.
